710	  `integrated` into a receipt (`IntegrationReceipt`, `core/operation.ts:351-367`) plus `WORK_INTEGRATED`.
711	- **Verification on the merged tree today:** `verifyMerged(command)` (`operation_git.ts:627-646`, `runVerifierShell` in the integration
712	  worktree) re-runs **only the integrating unit's own verifier**, and only if that verifier PASSED with executed tests (`:400-402`). A
713	  failure resets the merge (`:404-409`, `restoreIntegration`). Without a verifier the receipt says `NOT_RUN` and the unit is integrated
714	  "(not re-verified)" (`operation_runner.ts:565-571`). The crash path re-checks after the fact (`:345-379`). Existing test:
715	  `cli/test/operation_git.test.ts:170-194`.
716	- **The gap that fails the acceptance:** with units A and B, B integrated first and passing, then A merging cleanly, A's own narrow verifier
717	  passes on the merged tree, **B's verifier is never re-run**, and A is integrated even though B's tests now fail. That is the silent
718	  semantic conflict.

639	### Tests
640	**Characterization, before any refactor (slice 1); green before and after every later slice; fixtures regenerate only with
641	`NEXUS_TOOLS_RECORD=1`, and a diff needs review:**
642	1. `tool_surface_characterization`: `getEffectiveTools()` for a matrix covering:
643	   - role (main + every `AgentRole`), depth 0/1;
644	   - objective present/absent, skills present/absent, mask on/off;
645	   - groups none / one / all;
646	   - a delegated allow-list;
647	   - one fake MCP tool and one plugin tool.
648	
649	   It records names in order plus the SHA-256 and byte length of `JSON.stringify(tools)` into `model_tools_v1.json`. Also `HARNESS_TOOLS`
650	   bytes, `KNOWN_TOOLS`, serve-mcp `tools/list` and the ACP kind table.
651	2. `tool_dispatch_characterization`: for every registered name, record which source resolves (spine handler / registry handler /
652	   capability.handler / defaultHandler / bridge), `effect`, `mutating`, `changesWorkspace` → `tool_bindings_v1.json`.
653	3. Same file: the **decision matrix** from `dispatchToolCall` with a counting `onConfirm` and a stub bridge. Rows are a representative tool
654	   per effect class, `run_command` with a CS-9 allow/prompt/forbidden rule, a managed `require_human`, and a verification-path write.
655	   Columns are modes review/auto/read-only × fullAccess. It records ask / deny / run and the refusal text.
656	4. Same file: **side-effect order** for one write and one `run_command`: the sequence of observer, plugin, flight, journal and
657	   `logAudit` calls.
658	5. `mt1_core_import`: a child process imports `src/core/app.ts` with argv `--help run`: exit 0, empty stdout, no commander help, no file
659	   under a fresh HOME (MT-1's missing acceptance test).
660	
661	**New behaviour (slice 2):** `tool_registry.test.ts`:
662	- duplicate names, a missing binding, `spec.handler` plus a binding, and an extension with `read_workspace` effect are each refused at
663	  construction;
664	- **adding a tool = one `register({spec, binding, offer})`** makes it visible in `modelTools` and dispatchable, with no other file edited (a
665	  test-only tool);
666	- no exported API changes an effect after registration.
667	
668	**Focused suites run on every slice:** `command_rules_dispatch`, `managed_policy_dispatch`, `vllm_nullable_dispatch`, `approval_policy`,
669	`injection_gate`, `security_gates`, `sandbox_denial_events`, `role_deny_lists`, `tool_groups`, `capabilities`, `lsp_shape`,
670	`acp_mapping`, `acp_stdio`, `sidecar`, `subagent_delegation_authority`, `agt111_subagent_parity`, `verify_hostile`, `context_convergence`,
671	`critical_complexity`, and `check_critical_complexity.ts` output in the PR.
672	
673	### Slices
674	1. **S/M:** tests 1-5 and fixtures only. Safe any time; touches no source.
675	2. **M:** `tool_registry.ts`; `capabilities.ts`, `spine.ts`, `spine_handlers.ts`, `tools.ts`, `agent.ts` (`effectiveTools`), `parser.ts`,
676	   `mcp.ts`. Characterization stays identical. Hot: `agent.ts`, `spine_handlers.ts` (claimed now).
677	3. **L, as 3 PRs** in this order, each with `dispatchToolCallImpl` CC strictly lower:
678	   - 3a `afterToolCall` + `executeToolCall`;
679	   - 3b `admitToolCall` + `parseToolArguments`;
680	   - 3c `decideToolCall` + `confirmToolCall`.
681	
682	   Hot: `dispatch_tool_call.ts`.
683	4. **S:** baseline advance (D-MT2-2), owner-acknowledged.
684	
685	**When it is safest:** last of the five units, after the Codex lanes on `agent.ts`, `spine_handlers.ts`, `run_turn.ts`, `agent_support.ts`
686	and `objective.ts` release (context-maturity, WP-P10-02, PA-3/PA-4). Also after SB-1 slice 3 and PF-3 have touched dispatch and the sidecar,
687	and with a short, announced claim freeze on `dispatch_tool_call.ts`, `spine*.ts` and `capabilities.ts` during slice 3. Slice 1 can land
688	immediately and protects everyone else's work too.
689	
690	Out of scope: moving the sandbox into dispatch; parallel tool batches (Codex orchestrator); HK-1 hooks themselves; `runTurnImpl`;
691	splitting the TUI files.
692	
693	---
694	
695	## PA-2: verified merge arbitration
696	
697	**Acceptance (verbatim):** "two units whose changes conflict semantically (each passes alone) fail verification on the merged tree and
698	neither is integrated silently". Unit text: "when parallel units integrate, apply each diff, run verification on the merged tree, reject
699	on failure".
700	
701	### Definitions, from the code
702	- **Unit:** a `WorkUnit` of a durable operation (`nexus operation run`, `/batch`, `/team`) whose operation has `git.isolate: true`. Only
703	  then may `maxConcurrentUnits > 1` (`core/operation_schema.ts:~301`; `docs/v1.3.0/PA1_RESOURCE_ADMISSION.md`; `docs/v1.3.0/BATCH.md`).
704	  Each unit runs in its own worktree and branch from the integration tip (`core/operation_git.ts:1-11`). `/loop` and `/goal` are single
705	  workspace drivers and produce no merge (`loop.ts`, `goal.ts`), so they are outside PA-2.
706	- **Merge:** `OperationGit.integrate` (`operation_git.ts:274-428`): commit the unit's worktree; `git merge --no-ff --no-verify` the unit
707	  branch into `nexus/op-<key>/integration` in the integration worktree (`:388-397`); on a textual conflict, abort and return `conflict`
708	  (`:392-397`). Integration is **serialized** by `OperationRunner.enqueueIntegration` (`core/operation_runner.ts:485-506`).
709	  `integrateUnit` (`:512-580`) turns `conflict` and `failed` into operator decisions (`MERGE_CONFLICT`, `INTEGRATION_FAILED`) and
710	  `integrated` into a receipt (`IntegrationReceipt`, `core/operation.ts:351-367`) plus `WORK_INTEGRATED`.
711	- **Verification on the merged tree today:** `verifyMerged(command)` (`operation_git.ts:627-646`, `runVerifierShell` in the integration
712	  worktree) re-runs **only the integrating unit's own verifier**, and only if that verifier PASSED with executed tests (`:400-402`). A
713	  failure resets the merge (`:404-409`, `restoreIntegration`). Without a verifier the receipt says `NOT_RUN` and the unit is integrated
714	  "(not re-verified)" (`operation_runner.ts:565-571`). The crash path re-checks after the fact (`:345-379`). Existing test:
715	  `cli/test/operation_git.test.ts:170-194`.
716	- **The gap that fails the acceptance:** with units A and B, B integrated first and passing, then A merging cleanly, A's own narrow verifier
717	  passes on the merged tree, **B's verifier is never re-run**, and A is integrated even though B's tests now fail. That is the silent
718	  semantic conflict.
